response.sql: WITH gender_invoice_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as invoiced_order_count FROM Customers c INNER JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY c.gender), avg_table AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) as overall_avg FROM gender_invoice_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoiced_order_count) as average_figure, AVG(g.invoiced_order_count - at.overall_avg) as average_excess FROM gender_invoice_counts g CROSS JOIN avg_table at WHERE g.invoiced_order_count > at.overall_avg
